# OMP NInfer

> Durable local inference for coding agents: the qualified local inference appliance for
> Oh My Pi. Your coding session should survive the process. Oh My Pi (coding-agent client) →
> OMP NInfer (qualified appliance and release layer) → NInfer (inference engine) → Qwen3.8 27B
> (served model). Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Oh My Pi, Qwen, or
> NVIDIA.

Qualified on RTX 5090 · 4090 · 3090 — **v0.18.0** (published 2026-11-12, GitHub Latest), stock
**Oh My Pi 18.18.7** (`e325ffc7`). The 0.x series supports only the latest published release and its
exact manifest and profiles.
- **RTX 5090 container lane:** Windows 11 + Docker Desktop/WSL2 on loopback `127.0.0.1:18089`
  (local Windows client, manual macOS SSH tunnel preview, or Linux x64 client under WSL2); `v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.7` (source
  `48c8ac46` on [`Neroued/ninfer`](https://github.com/Neroued/ninfer) master `64d10fbf`, image `496195ec` on reused base `28857182`, server `804ef8ac`), profile
  `qwen38-5090-v0.13.0` (config `751d22dc`, kept from v0.13.0), model container v3 `81f924d4` (20.4 GB, served model ID `q38-ninfer`), DFlash2 draft window
  7, BF16 KV (146,368 automatic tokens), 131,072-token context, two requests in flight, schema 3
  checkpoints (isolated host `checkpoints-v018` mounted at the profile's `/checkpoints-v013` container path, strict origin auth, GPU-staged durable checkpoint export when the host RAM cache is full, operation-free prepare holding, bounded fresh-admission priority of 4 turns, bounded resume/fresh admission, byte-proven durable-generation host-cache reclaim, non-blocking export), JSON-schema output,
  128-character tool names, vision + tools.
- **RTX 4090 and RTX 3090 native Windows 11 lanes:** `v0.8.0-qwen38-4090-beta.3` (package
  `ac41700a`, server `a5266ae6`, profile `qwen38-4090-native-v0.8.0-beta.3`, build profile
  `native-v0.8.0-beta.3-rtx4090`, config `b71a2cff`, one active request / `C1`, 30 s pending
  timeout, 15,747.734375 MiB shared host RAM budget, 640 MiB admission headroom) and
  `v0.8.0-qwen38-3090-beta.3` (package `bf1ceaa9`, server `e5713286`, profile
  `qwen38-3090-native-v0.8.0-beta.3`, build profile `native-v0.8.0-beta.3-tc-rtx3090` enabling
  `sm_86` small-T tensor-core draft verification at `T=8/16`, config `674d5260`, two requests in flight / `C2`
  over one shared 131,072-token pool, 180 s pending timeout, `ninfer-native-3090: 2` in
  `examples/manual-tunnel/fail-closed.yml`, 20,867.734375 MiB shared host RAM budget, 768 MiB admission
  headroom, 350 W serving cap; `Install-Release.ps1` stops a running `v0.8.0-qwen38-{4090,3090}-beta.2`
  lane through its own controller and preserves it for `Control-Release.ps1 -Action Rollback`, while
  `Control-Release.ps1` restores the GPU-owner lease on a refused `Stop`) on loopback
  `127.0.0.1:18082`, rebuilt from shared frozen engine source `48c8ac46` on `Neroued/ninfer` master
  `64d10fbf`, UUID-bound on one two-GPU host (sequential single-GPU serving, one lane at a time),
  shared model container v3 `81f924d4` (20.4 GB, `qwen3_8_27b-v3.ninfer`; served model IDs
  `qwen3.8-27b` on RTX 4090 and `q38-ninfer` on RTX 3090), DFlash2 draft window 7 (`K=7`,
  `proposal: "artifact-default"`, `Q4_G64_FP16` draft MLP, host-mapped `token_embedding`), INT8 KV,
  `Group64` A8 and FP32 head logits off, 131,072-token context, 1,024-token prefill chunk, two extra
  device-state slots, schema 3 checkpoints (`session-checkpoints-v3`, strict origin auth),
  JSON-schema output, 128-character tool names, SPDX + CycloneDX dependency SBOMs, text + tools (no vision).
- **Proof:** Fresh v0.18.0 acceptance on frozen candidate commit `2a735da0` across five documented routes
  (31 executable blocks), all three stock Oh My Pi 18.18.7 client binaries (macOS arm64 preview, Windows x64, Linux x64
  under WSL2), initial-window RTX 4090 and third-execution RTX 3090 native Windows public installs, C1/C2
  probes, and independent restoration without a waiver (owner-operated, 406.876 s RTX 5090 hold, 509.857 s
  RTX 4090 window, 1,439.367 s RTX 3090 window; on RTX 3090, attempt 1 passed all 7 documented
  blocks, failed its post-route stock OMP subagent check on malformed `task` tool arguments, and restored,
  attempt 2 ran while the host's system drive was full with 0.39 GiB free when measured afterwards — 27 checkpoint writes failed with
  OS disk-full error 112, checkpoint saves were refused for capacity, and admission waited behind an
  unsettled checkpoint save across 4 HTTP 503 `deferred by a pending checkpoint save` timeouts before a 900 s
  compaction timeout and empty-session Start/Stop recovery — and a founder-authorized third execution in fresh
  workspaces with an enforced 60 GiB free-space floor (`63.08` GiB free, recorded in
  shared native driver `accept-rtx4090-route.py`'s single `--attempt 2` rerun slot because the frozen driver accepts only `--attempt 1|2`) passed every phase with zero disk-full errors,
  `2` committed compactions in `747.00` s, zero HTTP
  503 responses, compaction receipt `cfa89628`, and anonymous public install, showing the request-level HTTP 503 half of
  [`alphastorm/ninfer#89`](https://github.com/alphastorm/ninfer/issues/89) reproduced in acceptance only under
  disk exhaustion); all three lane runtime qualifications are fresh at `48c8ac46` (RTX
  5090 181.52 tok/s server decode and 56.90 s / 56.896 s cold exact 130,048-token retrieval; RTX 4090
  253.71 tok/s C1 decode and 83.45 s / 83.451 s exact retrieval; RTX 3090 `tc` 227.17 tok/s C1 decode and
  189.12 s / 189.119 s exact retrieval; native speed gates vs published `beta.2` under bound passing
  1,120-prompt EXP-085 quality screens: RTX 3090 `tc` weighted 1.5373 / min 1.3503, 84/84 within-engine
  and 35/84 cross-engine identical; RTX 4090 weighted 1.0000 / min 0.9992, 115/115 identical).

## Release authorities

- [Release manifest](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.18.0/releases/v0.18.0/manifest.json): exact client, runtime, model, and profile pins
- [Release notes](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.18.0/releases/v0.18.0/NINFER_RELEASE_NOTES.md): release composition, client SHA-256 digests, acceptance, and support boundaries
- [Tagged quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.18.0/docs/QUICKSTART.md): immutable installation guide for the current release

## Living canonical documents
